general.contact: a margin or clearance of exactly 0; touching by method B is a nonempty clipped set of area 0
general.past: 10^-30 beyond contact: for a pair, the centre-line parameter 10^-30 beyond its contact value (a move of 10^-30 times the centres' distance); for a wall or a side, 10^-30 in length
general.centre-line method: square b of a pair moves by t * (c_a - c_b); t at contact is exact (l83_geom.closing_parameter)
general.scope of incremental controls: G1, G2, G5, S4c and S4p change one square: they are decided by both methods on every pair of the changed square and on its walls; every other square and pair is byte-identical to the accepted base check. S1a to S1d change only the side: every square's walls are decided again by both methods, and the pairs, which do not depend on the side, are the base check's.
general.whole-file controls: G6 and G8 are decided by both methods over every square, wall and pair
